retentionUpdate: first successful summary ratio replaces prior; then EMA alpha 0.3
cycleEstimate: 64 deterministic cycles, discard first 8; no task horizon
development: the 54 trace-opportunity cells; all already seen

validation.generation: xorshift32; steady growth base 12000 plus uniform 0..12000, slow base 2000 plus uniform 0..6000; staged first 240 growth items steady then slow, same switch point at both lengths

billing: existing simulator, all ordinary input/output and summary usage; summary rate and output from complete development feedback provided equally to candidate and world
caching: no cached prefix on first call, then warm; each summary resets prefix
metrics: per-cell cost components, summaries, growth fingerprint, prior/observed decisions, selected boundary histogram, 70% overshoots; retain all losses and ties
interpretation: fresh synthetic workload check after defining candidate, not independent real tasks or proof of quality; no statistical generalization claim
promotion: research simulator only; no production defaults, Pi control or paid requests
